svg.title: Figure 17 · Covariance eigenvalues and shrinkage
svg.desc: A separate synthetic 30-stock, 60-month panel is generated from five common factors and independent specific risk. Diagonal shrinkage is a declared 50% example, not an estimated optimal intensity.
